model.name: bonsai-30b-from-27b-moe
model.model_desc: 27B qwen35 MoE (Bonsai-27B) ternary export -> ~30B, kept in the teacher 27B MoE token space (n_vocab 248320)
model.compressed_token_input_note: Set true (or env COMPRESSED_INPUT=1) to feed the model CHUNKED/compressed tokens (chunk_id = vocab_offset + floor(rawId/chunk_size)) instead of raw ids; the compressed-token scoring (footprint = sum of ids) always runs.

etokens.note: E-TOKEN COMPRESSION SYSTEM (corrected): data/Etokens.json stores recallable functions etoken(e1) -> (o1,o2,o3,o2,o4) (the original token tuple, deduped of effective adjacent repeats). On startup the pre-tokenized token DB (data/project-tokens.json) is fed through the e-tokenizer to BUILD the base Etokens.json; then every teacher-generated chunk is e-tokenized and MERGED back live (etokens.live_update). The etoken id (in moe.new_token_base..+new_token_count) is the deterministic/recallable handle in the reserved range. TRAIN SCOPE (user directive): we are ONLY training the NEW ~3B parameters (the 30B-27B delta: mutation / mtp_head / new_token / compr* experts — isNewNetwork in teacher-live.mjs) to use the new etokens and produce COMPRESSED (etoken) output. Base 27B experts E1..E5 are NOT trained for etoken emission. Later we move to the model as a whole using this 3B 'expert' to save space/memory. ATM we train the final 3B expert/set to give compressed token output: etoken disqualification + repeat-train-top-k + phase-1 compressed-output reward apply ONLY to new-3B networks. An expert that produces a token whose ORIGINAL token is NOT in the teacher's top-k is DISQUALIFIED (no reward) for the round, and the etoken id is repeat-trained into each new expert's top-k until it appears (etokens.mjs).

moe.new_token_formula_note: USER CORRECTION: the compressed token must be a GENUINELY NEW token (a reserved id in [new_token_base, new_token_base+new_token_count)), NOT sum%n_vocab folded onto an existing vocab token. Its VALUE = the sum of the constituent token ids (footprint); its reserved id = new_token_base + (rawSum % new_token_count) — deterministic and decompressible (the rawSum is recoverable). create_new_token_experts=true makes the harness ADD a new MoE expert per distinct new token (NT<idx>) so each new token has its own network that learns to emit it, then steering/logit-bias 'convinces' the model to use that new token.
moe.compressor_note: EACH COMPRESSOR MUST USE ONLY COMPRESSOR TOKENS: experts designated as compressors (role starts with 'compr' or listed in compressor_experts) may only route/emit tokens from the compressor-token set (the compressed-chunk / formulaic tokens in newTokenSet), never the general vocabulary. This is what makes the extra layers fight to become token-COMPRESSOR layers (they can only express compressed tokens). allow_new_token_output=true lets those compressor experts actually EMIT the compressed new token as part of the scored output (so 500x can fire), instead of only matching it one-directionally. skip_teacher_when_poor / self_update_when_poor: when the student top-k is BAD (best overlap < poor_topk_threshold), DON'T spend resources having the teacher generate a fresh top-k — reuse the existing reference and just update the COMPRESSION experts from the student's own generation output instead.

expert_structure.note: GRANULAR 3B STRUCTURE (user-corrected): MULTIPLE 3B segments trained in parallel (n_segments_3b=3), only the BEST is attached. We do NOT preset neurons/expert — sizes SEED small and EVOLVE via rewiring. REWIRING IS RANK-SCALED (user): the attached BEST segment NEVER changes ('best contains no change ever'); LOSERS mutate by rank 'layer change for less performing models increases based on position': loser at 1-based rank `place` changes (place-1)*5% of its neurons (floor 0 at the top loser, worst loser mutates most aggressively). rewire_every=steps between rewires; rewire_rate=base fraction (per-place step is +5%).

EMTP.mutation: NextN/MTP decoder block (blk.64) — predicts the NEXT token one step ahead of the trunk
EMTP.training_formula: mtp_next_match = whether the MTP head's predicted next token (teacher's +1 offset) lands in the teacher's actual next top-k; MTP value accumulates like other experts
EMTP.note: The MTP (multi-token-prediction) head must be trained too: it is registered as a first-class MoE expert so it is scored against the teacher's NEXT-token top-k and its gate value evolves via the same sigmoid accumulation as E1..E101.

routing.note: only the TOP 2 experts by top-k affinity are kept active for the token set

base.note: +1 per token in student's top-n/k that's in teacher's top-n/k; +1 per token in student's top-n/p that's in teacher's top-n/p; +2 per student CHOSEN token that's in the teacher's ACTUAL emitted top-k

bonus.note: bonus = 100 * step (running); top-k allowed is wide now, will narrow later

value_generation.note: 500x when the 5-token compression footprint token appears in the top-k of the next-5 AND a match is in the top-100 of the next 5 generated tokens

penalties.note: subtract from total when flagged; adjust live via UI

curve.note: exponential reward for matching the (perfect) teacher's top-k curve: each matched teacher slot i pays per_topk_token_match * exp_base^((i+1)/exp_scaler), so MORE matches = MORE reward (progressively). A compressed token that lands on a teacher slot counts and is multiplied by compressed_token_mult. New-token-system tokens in the teacher top-k are also heavily rewarded.

compression.note:
compression_reward = compressionRatio * baseEffectiveTokens * ( 1 + textLengthGenerated / tokensSaved ) ; 
compressionRatio = referenceTokens / emittedTokens ; tokensSaved = referenceTokens - emittedTokens. If >=min_pct of generated tokens match new-token-system created tokens, multiply by new_token_match_mult * tokensSaved. DEGENERATE GUARD: if the student emits ALL the same token (a repeated-token attractor like '/'), the compression reward is frozen to 0 (degenerate_partial=false) and degenerate_penalty is applied, so a collapsed student can't farm points for trivially repeating one token.

two_phase.note: USER DESIGN: (PHASE 1) the NEW networks (all mutation + MTP experts beyond the 5 base ones) are trained to FAVOR compressed tokens — each new network that emits a compressed/new token (in newTokenSet) earns new_net_compression_weight per position, so the added networks become token-COMPRESSORS. (PHASE 2) the new compressed experts must then reproduce the SAME SHAPE as if they weren't attached: when a new network is active, its position's top-k must match the BASE (un-attached, E1-E5) experts' top-k at that position (reconstruct_min_overlap) — scoring reconstruct_weight times the base-overlap. Setting phase=2 gates reconstruction scoring on; phase=1 gates the compression-favor on. Both reward only NEW networks (role mutation/mtp_head), never the base experts.

otoken_sequence.note: HARSHER ENVIRONMENT (user): score experts against a SAVED TEACHER CHUNK (the etoken/otoken sequence the teacher produced, of teacher_chunk_length traces). No free 'anything in top-k' bonus. An expert earns generated_match_pts when its FIRST saved otoken == the otoken it GENERATED (more points than just top-k). A top-k-only match earns topk_only_pts (right direction but not generated). Completeness multiplier: 'more perfect otokens = bigger base multiplier' and 'missing % of otokens in score = score / missing%' — so 1/100 saved gives little, 99/100 saved with a top-k match is super close to perfect. First PERFECT response (whole otoken sequence match) = immediate round end, placed first; on a tie the NEXT otoken is compared (longest completed prefix wins).

compare.note: USER DIRECTIVE + ROOT-CAUSE FIX: analyse the teacher/student top-k head-to-head. identical_settings=false (CHANGED 2026-08-16) so the TEACHER uses top_k/top_p/temperature above (cold, coherent) while the STUDENT uses its OWN emit settings (sampling.emit.student: temperature 2.0, top_k 100, top_p 0.99) — the TQ1_0 student verifiably COLLAPSES to a single repeated token ('apart') at cold temp 0.7, flattening the score graph. Hot student sampling breaks the collapse so its top-k can overlap the teacher's coherent top-k. Both now generate a real multi-token chunk (compareN=STUDENT_STEP) instead of a single top-1 token.

sampling.note: top-k sliders are capped at 100 (NOT 100k). view_top_k = how many top tokens the model looks at (logprobs); emit.* limits top-k/top-p/temperature sampling so the teacher stays coherent. STUDENT TEMPERATURE 2.0 + top_k 100: the native TQ1_0 student produces a delta-peaked (collapsed) distribution at temp 0.7 — every position emits the same token. Raising temperature ~2.0 (VERIFIED) breaks the collapse and yields varied output, so the expert-steering logit bias can actually nudge it toward teacher top-k and let overlap climb. noise_to_layer = per-token noise added to layers for the next output token.

training.note: steps_per_round * rounds_before_reset decide round reset cadence. pause_every_n_steps>0 auto-pauses the harness every N training steps (0 = never). Each auto-pause re-seeds the prompt as the default input.

windowing.note: LOOP-AND-INCREMENT training: all experts + MTP share the SAME teacher top-k over a fixed window of the first N tokens (not continuous forward streaming). TRAIN TILL IT WORKS: a tier only advances once the student CONVERGES on the window's teacher top-k (student↔teacher top-k overlap >= identity_tolerance) — this forces the model to actually learn each window before growing N. max_loops_per_tier is the escape hatch (advance anyway after that many loops) so an unlearnable window can't deadlock the run. Then increment N: 8, 9, ... until max_tokens (2000).

expert_policy.note: at each round reset: top_n_survive experts keep their values. update_losing_experts = how many of the WORST (weakest) experts get updated; every losing_experts_update_every steps those losing experts are re-seeded. winner_similarity (0-1): when a losing/surpassed expert is refreshed, it is blended toward the winning/unculled (top_n_survive kept) experts so the best, when surpassed, does NOT decay too much — specifically anchored to the SINGLE kept expert it is most similar to (so a challenger can be a near-twin of ONE winner and CAN overtake it). 0 = old harsh fresh-random decay, 1 = fully pulled to that one kept expert (tiny jitter to avoid clones). All adjustable.
